arguments.sql:
SELECT c.leadershipSkills, c.isPromo, c.types, COUNT(*) AS printings
FROM cards AS c
WHERE c.leadershipSkills IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY c.leadershipSkills, c.isPromo, c.types
ORDER BY printings DESC
LIMIT 35

arguments.sql:
WITH promo_cards AS (
    SELECT c.name, SUM(1) AS promo_printings
    FROM cards AS c
    WHERE c.isPromo = 1
    GROUP BY c.name
)
SELECT c.name, COUNT(*) AS eligible_printings,
       COUNT(DISTINCT c.scryfallOracleId) AS oracle_ids,
       SUM(c.isPromo) AS eligible_promo_printings,
       MAX(p.promo_printings) AS promo_printings
FROM cards AS c
JOIN promo_cards AS p ON p.name = c.name
WHERE ',' || c.types || ',' LIKE '%,Creature,%'
  AND c.leadershipSkills LIKE '%''brawl'': True%'
GROUP BY c.name
ORDER BY c.name
